business.about: Titan Company Ltd is among India’s most respected lifestyle companies. It has established leadership positions in the Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear categories led by its trusted brands and differentiated customer experience. It was founded in 1984 as a joint-venture between TATA Group and Tamilnadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO). [1]

promises.opening: welcome to Titan Company Limited's Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode, and there will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance during the conference call, please signal an operator by pressing star then zero on your touch-tone phone. Please note that this conference is being recorded. I now hand the conference over to Mr. Ajoy Chawla, Managing Director, Titan Company Limited. Thank you, and over to you, Mr. Chawla. Ajoy Chawla: Thank you. Good evening to everybody on the call. Thank you for being part of this. It has been another very fulfilling quarter. We have seen fantastic growth at a consolidated level across most of our brands and businesses, and all of them clocking in very healthy growths, driven, of course, by a lot of focus on innovation and prioritizing growth over everything else, given the opportunity that India offers. It looks like very exciting times for us, despite it being a very volatile quarter in terms of some macros. But overall, a very, very good quarter. With that, I hand over to Ashok, our CFO, to share some opening remarks. Ashok Sonthalia: Thank you, Ajoy. Good evening, everyone. I just thought I will take this opportunity to clarify on particularly two items, so that we all are on same page. One is related to customs duty gains. We continue to, as we spoke after quarter one, this quarter also saw a good amount of customs duty gain, which is estimated at ₹490 crores for quarter two in Titan Jewellery division and ₹46 crores in CaratLane. Normalized margin, once you do adjustment for this, on Titan Jewellery business would be 11.1%. The other thing in jewellery, which we have spoken last time, that a large part of MTM gain of quarter one reversed this quarter, which would impact jewellery margin by about 60 basis points. And if you normalize for that, then TMZ, which is Titan Jewellery business margin, would be 11.7%. Another important item, which is rather new on our P&L, on the face of P&L we have disclosed it separately, is related to liability towards the second tranche for the Damas acquisition. This amount is ₹671 crores. As per Ind AS 109, any financial liability has to be fair valued at every accounting period. And with the current environment, when we looked at our liability at the end of four years, which was accounted for in our books of accounts at ₹1,668 crores, the reassessed liability is less by ₹671 crores. Please note that this assessment will happen at the end of every quarter, and depending on the recovery trajectory of the Damas, there could be pluses and minuses on account of this. But we will continue to disclose it separately so that everyone can understand the nature of that number, and all other performance metrics are looked at normalizing for this adjustment. We Titan Company Limited November 05, 2026 Page 3 of 17 Sensitivity: Internal continue to certainly believe in the long-term opportunity that Damas represents, and we believe as soon as the geopolitical environment and the conflict situation improves, all the investments are in place to ensure that that long-term opportunity gets realized at the Titan group level. With that, I will open the floor for questions, and we will be very happy to answer. All of us are here to answer your questions. Thank you. Moderator: Thank you very much, Sir. We will now
